description: This PHP source file defines the Icon class within the Goteo Model namespace. It manages icon data, including retrieval, listing, validation, and saving of icon records, along with associated properties and methods. It also interacts with related entities such as language translations, licenses, rewards, and the database.

classes.name: Icon
classes.description: Model class representing icons used for rewards, including methods for retrieving, validating, saving, and listing icons, as well as handling language support and associated licenses.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific icon by its ID, including localized name and description based on language.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all icons, optionally filtered by group, with support for localization.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Lists icons that are used in projects, optionally filtered by group, including localization.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the icon data, ensuring the name is present.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates the icon record in the database after validation.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Returns predefined icon groups: 'Retorno colectivo' and 'Recompensa individual'.
